"""URL slugs."""

import re


def slugify(title):

"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents folded to their base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = s.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
EOF
cat > textutil/truncate.py <<'EOF'
"""Text truncation for previews."""


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = limit - 3
    if budget <= 0:
        return "..."[:limit]
    # Position just past the budget: if it lands on whitespace, text[:budget] ends on a full word.
    if text[budget].isspace():
        head = text[:budget]
    else:
        head = text[:budget]
        cut = max(head.rfind(" "), head.rfind("\t"), head.rfind("\n"))
        head = head[:cut] if cut >= 0 else ""
    head = head.rstrip()
    if not head:
        return "..."
    return head + "..."
EOF

    if budget <= 0:
        return "..."[:limit]
    # Position just past the budget: if it lands on whitespace, text[:budget] ends on a full word.
    head = text[:budget]
    if not text[budget].isspace():
        # Mid-word: drop the partial word, keep only whole words before it.
        cut = max(head.rfind(" "), head.rfind("\t"), head.rfind("\n"))
        head = head[:cut] if cut >= 0 else ""
    head = head.rstrip()
    if not head:
        return "..."
    return head + "..."
